offers: Shelf-audit dashboard by store, area and distributor
approvedClaims: Runs on existing phones and needs no new hardware
Designed for crowded shelves and phone photos in normal store light, including small kirana stores
Accepts only in-app camera photos with time and location, requests surprise re-checks, and flags stores whose shelves look perfect while sales fall
aiQuestions: What is the best shelf audit software for FMCG companies in India?
How can I measure share of shelf in kirana stores using phone photos?
Which image recognition tools detect out-of-stock products in small retail stores?
How do I check planogram compliance across thousands of general trade stores?
How can I stop salesmen from staging shelves in retail audits?
What are alternatives to Trax for retail execution in India?
name: DukaanLens
oneLiner: A shelf-audit tool for FMCG sales teams. A salesman photographs a kirana store shelf in the app, and computer vision reports out-of-stocks, share of shelf, planogram compliance and price-label mismatches.
idealBuyer: FMCG brands (biscuits and snacks, beverages, personal care) that sell through Indian kirana stores and have a field sales team. The site gives no company size. Buyers named: sales heads (main), trade marketing managers and category managers (share-of-shelf page).
notAFit: Shop owners and individual retailers; students and job seekers; agencies, consultants and resellers; competitors and other shelf-audit vendors; companies with no field sales team.
